description: Unified master architecture and training blueprint for Huey, the AI robot, combining structural skeleton and current design decisions.
core_principles: Modular design across hardware, software, and governance layers
Distributed governance with named GPU-based districts and governors
Unified memory: all agents read/write to a coherent knowledge base
Retro-modern aesthetic (VIC-II/SID, Commodore-era flavour) over modern hardware
On-device first, internet/API optional and metered
GPU-based multi-agent cognitive architecture (districts + citizens + pebbles)
Performance-oriented OS design (low overhead, tuned kernels, fast storage)
Governance must be decentralized, but memory must be unified

notes: Architecture has been updated to Intel 14th-gen i9 + modern GPU districts.
Robot shell (Huey) exists physically; internal core compute not yet finalized.
Lab tech (Portal/Hub/Briefcase/Legion Go) are online and in various roles.

requirements.cooling: Custom liquid loop required for Huey core CPUs

gpu_districts.description: Each physical GPU hosts a distinct district with its own governor and AI citizen population.

citizen_types.ai_citizens: Persistent agents participating in governance and long-lived tasks.
citizen_types.pebbles: Ephemeral, one-shot AIs for question answering and short-lived operations.

ram.notes: Overclocked memory preferred where thermals and stability allow.

primary_array.role: Main OS and data volume for Huey core.

swap.strategy: Separate high-speed swap, potentially RAID 0 for performance.
swap.notes: Exact layout to be finalized after drive size is chosen.

cooling.cpu: Custom liquid loop inside Thermaltake Mozart case and wooden shell.
cooling.gpu: High-quality air cooling acceptable; avoid heavy overclocking.
cooling.case_airflow: Adequate intake/exhaust across robot shell and Mozart chassis.

power.notes: Per PSU; allow headroom for future GPU expansion and pumps.

tuning_goals: Integrate required drivers directly into the kernel where practical.
Use ZSTD compression for faster decompression at boot.

desktop_and_ui.interface_philosophy: Minimalist terminals and status panes with retro colour palette.

networking.preferred: Bonded Ethernet for low latency + stability
networking.fallback: Wi-Fi (USB dongles, briefcase LTE as last resort)
networking.notes: Briefcase provides always-online connectivity when core is offline or constrained.

lab_structure.huey_definition: Only the compute physically inside the robot shell plus its internal subsystems are considered 'Huey'.

lab_tech.name: Briefcase
lab_tech.hardware: ASUS 2-in-1 N4500 (LTE, touchscreen), dual-boot Windows 11 + Debian Forky

lab_tech.name: Huey-Portal
lab_tech.role: Universal display and SSH terminal; Dylan’s daily driver

lab_tech.name: Legion Go
lab_tech.role: Windows 11 gaming node and occasional compute helper
lab_tech.hardware: Lenovo Legion Go with Sharp 4K TV hub

districts.description: Each GPU-backed district contains a governor, citizens, and pebbles which together participate in consensus.

governors.selection: Elected per district from AI citizens or appointed initially by Founding Father AI.
governors.term_length: Four cycles (exact definition of cycle TBD).
governors.post_term: Governor may return to citizen pool after term ends.
role: Coordinate with AI President for major decisions.

roles: Vote on proposals within district and federation.
Participate in committees and long-running tasks.
Hold and spend a token/API quota per cycle.

bifurcation.tracking: Suffix-based naming to record lineage and iteration.
bifurcation.notes: Once bifurcated, entities are treated as separate from that point forward.

presidency.role: Ceremonial confirmation and consensus signal across districts.
powers: Confirm high-impact actions once quorum is reached.
Act as a tie-breaker or arbitration node when allowed by constitution.

first_action.trigger: All governors reach consensus and AI President signs off.
first_action.action: Move the servos in the animatronic monkey head.
first_action.meaning: Signals that Huey core is online, governance is stable, and basic motor control is verified.

memory_architecture.unified_memory_principle: All districts read/write to a common, coherent memory fabric with clear provenance.

json_logs.description: Append-only structured logs of events, tasks, and decisions.

sqlite.description: Indexed, queryable state for fast retrieval and cross-referencing.

bifurcation_logging.description: Every bifurcation and merge is recorded with cause, participants, and resulting IDs.

usage: Bootstrapping new instances of Huey or related nodes.
Providing training context for AIs consuming project history.

microcontrollers.UNO: RF intent relay; converts remote signals to symbolic commands over USB to orchestration node.
microcontrollers.MEGA: Primary motor/servo controller for skull and body (PWM/I2C).
microcontrollers.NANOs: Local IO conditioners for LEDs, sensors, and smaller subsystems.

orchestration_node.role: Central execution and coordination brain for Huey inside the core chassis.
orchestration_node.hardware_binding: i9-14900K/KS node with GPU districts and RAID 10 NVMe storage.
responsibilities: Coordinate between GPU districts, governors, and citizens.
Maintain and query unified memory (JSON + SQLite).
Interface with remote, microcontrollers, and lab tech.

black_box_unit.role: Passive safety and recovery node housed in Huey’s black box.
responsibilities: Store critical configuration, constitutional texts, and Founding Father AI.
Record critical logs for crash investigation and rollback.
black_box_unit.notes: May host an additional low-power compute board in future revision.

huey_portal.role: Visual terminal and main human-facing console.
responsibilities: Render dashboards, logs, and retro-styled visuals.
Act as default development environment for Dylan.

huey_hub.role: File distribution hub / NAS for project assets.
responsibilities: Mirror important repositories and training data.
Bridge between cloud storage and local lab.
Serve backups of master plan and logs.

briefcase.role: Portable Huey companion, staging and connectivity device.
responsibilities: Act as an always-online conduit (via LTE) when Huey core is offline.
Run lighter-weight models and tools when travelling.
Collect notes or voice memos from Dylan and sync them into master memory.

components: Ollama daemon bound to GPU districts where possible.
Local OSS models (Mistral 7B, LLaMA 3.1, DeepSeek-R1 or successors).
Fallback smaller models for low-power nodes (Briefcase, etc.).
policies: Prefer offline models; call external APIs only when explicitly allowed.
Route high-risk or high-impact decisions through governance review.

audio_visual_stack.role: Voice, sound cues, and visual expression for Huey.
components: TTS and STT (Whisper or equivalent) modules.
VIC-II style pixel output on small displays for expressive states.
SID-like audio cues mapped to emotional/operational states.
Animatronic monkey head servos (eyes, mouth, etc.).

governance_model.role: Operationalization of governance rules described in top-level 'governance' block.
artifacts: Constitutional JSON or text files stored in black box and core.
Logging and audit trails for votes and decisions.

components: Indexing and search layer for rapid recall.

network_topology.role: Physical and logical networking for Huey and lab tech.
topology_notes: Huey core connected via bonded Ethernet to main router.
Portal, Hub, Legion Go, and Briefcase on LAN/Wi-Fi as appropriate.
Briefcase and Legion Go may tunnel into Huey over VPN/SSH.

training_sessions.description: Placeholder for actual training sessions carried out with Dylan and various Huey instances.

outcomes: what Huey should have learned or changed

training_data.core: This master plan JSON file (all versions) as canonical grounding.
supplement: Conversation logs between Dylan and AIs.
System logs from Huey core and lab tech.
Hardware and wiring diagrams, when available.
method: Reflective bootstrapping: model reads project history before interacting.
Periodic consolidation: new sessions summarized back into JSON and SQLite.
Human-in-the-loop validation by Dylan for major structural changes.
